topic.title: Research topic
topic.description: One sentence describing the area you want to investigate. The LLM will generate candidate questions from this. Be specific — vague topics produce vague questions.
examples: The impact of large language models on systematic review screening accuracy

max_questions.title: Number of candidate questions
max_questions.description: How many candidate research questions to generate. 3–7 is a good range.

provider.title: LLM provider
provider.description: Which API to call. Anthropic = Claude, OpenAI = GPT, Ollama = local (no API key needed).

model.title: Model
model.description: Specific model identifier for the provider above. Defaults below match the chosen provider.
